rounds.name: Round 1, challenger A
rounds.reviewer: independent general-purpose agent, read-only, did not author findings; checked HIGH findings, economy and main steps 1-20 at bc66eff
rounds.summary: Confirmed GA-11, GA-13, GA-24 rule, GA-40, GA-41, GA-44, GA-45, GA-81, GA-88 and the draft totals (15,670; main 2,826). Ten objections, all accepted in whole or part.

objections.objection: GA-10 overstated: only the 8 key species give large blocks; other trees drop the plain Log, which chops to small blocks, so the hammer works for them.
objections.resolution: Accepted. GA-10 rewritten to cover both cases; GA-12 corrected (plain Log stacks to 5).

objections.objection: Missed: a player who felled a plain-Log tree cannot make the Chopping block (needs a Large block; no small-to-large recipe).
objections.resolution: Accepted. Folded into GA-10 (name a key-species tree in rows 9-11 and 16).

objections.objection: Missed: a tree too short for one log gives no log (server_items.gd:6683, 6748).
objections.resolution: Accepted as GA-35 (fell, gather:log).

objections.objection: GA-21: 'its foundations come after it' is false; a Crude - Foundation raised 0.5 m qualifies.
objections.resolution: Accepted. Ordering claim removed; correction names the Crude - Foundation.

objections.objection: GA-23: the approved catalog item 1 [D1] (Dave) supports the iron-first wilderness route; bronze order is a creator choice.
objections.resolution: Accepted. Reclassified OWNER_DECISION with no status effect; new creator question Q11.

objections.objection: GA-20: a lit station needs no fuel; only a cold one needs Charcoal or Coal to light it.
objections.resolution: Accepted. Wording corrected.

objections.objection: GA-70: Hob ceiling omits the starting 300 (1.70x, not 1.76x); depends on the ASSUMED effort model; single-player; net of purchases; picking wage is Dave's 40-60 per 4 h with 0.2 as Sal's midpoint.
objections.resolution: Accepted. GA-70 and the summary now say 1.70x, label both ratios ASSUMED, give the sensitivity and cite the wage's true origin.

objections.objection: GA-42 recommended fell 3 copper though the draft already proposes 6.
objections.resolution: Accepted. Recommendation is now the draft's own values (twine 4, fell 6, story 3).

objections.objection: activity:medium_fire is PASS though GA-45 says it has no completion event.
objections.resolution: Kept by design: the brief makes design status and runtime support independent columns. The row is runtime NEW_EVENT_REQUIRED; section 1 now states how many PASS goals need runtime work.

objections.objection: Fire row never mentions rain.
objections.resolution: Accepted into GA-34 (LOW).

rounds.name: Round 1, challenger B (gate-reviewer)
rounds.reviewer: independent gate-reviewer agent, read-only; checked all 28 main PASS rows, about 40 additional PASS rows, 20 BLOCKED/NC rows and report/ledger consistency at bc66eff
rounds.summary: GA-01 to GA-04 source claims held against a code-wide search; headline counts reconcile; overall NOT READY verdict stands. Twelve objections; PASS inflation found on drink and berries.

objections.objection: drink is over-passed: a new character starts with full water, so drinking at once does not count; salt water and held containers also block it.
objections.resolution: Accepted (verified server_items.gd:10218, 18408-18412, 1104-1109). New GA-36; drink and berries now NEEDS_CORRECTION.

objections.objection: berries: same mechanism with hunger.
objections.resolution: Accepted into GA-36.

objections.objection: GA-12 applied to two log-cost builds but not the other ~20.
objections.resolution: Accepted. GA-12 now applies only where logs are first taught; the shared rule is GA-37 (no status effect) on every log-cost build.

objections.objection: gather:clay How-to still holds a placeholder.
objections.resolution: Accepted. Added to GA-05; now NEEDS_CORRECTION.

objections.objection: craft:wooden_block(_soft) runtime is EXISTING: the small-block recipe runs through _craft_tick.
objections.resolution: Accepted. Runtime overridden to EXISTING; removed from GA-13 (GA-10 still applies).

objections.objection: GA-10 over-generalised (same as challenger A).
objections.resolution: Accepted (see above).

objections.objection: GA-40 attributed to 28 goals; drink and fibre have no after.
objections.resolution: Accepted. Now computed from the data (26).

objections.objection: GA-24 door/doorway counts imprecise.
objections.resolution: Accepted. Count claim removed from the title.

objections.objection: Missed: one carcass dressing pays knife plus hide, bone and fat; site finish credits the finisher.
objections.resolution: Accepted as GA-38 (design recommendation).

objections.objection: Wool goods rest on bighorn only.
objections.resolution: Accepted as GA-39: the wool family is NEEDS_TEST (computed from the dependency graph).

objections.objection: GA-18 evidence is roof-only but was attached to floor and wall.
objections.resolution: Accepted. Narrowed to the two roof goals.

objections.objection: GA-42 duplicated in sections 11 and 12; milestone table order.
objections.resolution: Accepted. Fixed in the report generator.

rounds.name: Round 2, gate review of 84ebc66
rounds.reviewer: independent gate-reviewer agent, read-only (no git tool); re-checked counts, round-1 resolutions, 15 PASS rows against data, section list, secrets
rounds.summary: Verdict NOT MERGE-READY on two items: SHA binding (the branch moved during the review) and one half-applied round-1 resolution. Counts reconcile; no inflated PASS in its sample; all 18 sections present; no secrets or model identifiers.

objections.objection: SHA binding: review started at cd9b8c7, branch moved to 84ebc66.
objections.resolution: Accepted. A fresh gate review is run on the final head with the SHA, status and diff scope supplied.

objections.objection: GA-42 / Q3 / ledger still recommended fell 3 copper while the text said the draft's 6.
objections.resolution: Accepted. tools/economy.py now recommends the draft's own values for converted legacy rewards (twine 4, fell 6, story 3); totals regenerated (3,059; main 1,307); Q3 corrected; ws_economy.md annotated (work/ws_economy.json is authoritative for all totals).

objections.objection: Walkthrough YES cells contradict BLOCKED statuses.
objections.resolution: Accepted. The preface now states the tables are first-pass readings and the Status column and ledger are authoritative, naming GA-01..04 and GA-31.

objections.objection: Depth of review not in the headline numbers.
objections.resolution: Accepted. Section 1 and section 18 now state 323 individual / 328 rule-only and how many PASS verdicts are rule-only.

objections.objection: 'Every count is computed, not typed' is untrue; '36 overlap (GA-47, GA-48)' does not match those findings.
objections.resolution: Accepted. Claim narrowed and the quoted figures named with their sources; 36 now cited to ws_catalog.md section 5.

objections.objection: Effect rules inconsistent: engine-wide completion defects carry no status effect.
objections.resolution: Accepted. Section 2 now says this is deliberate and where those defects are recorded (runtime_support).

objections.objection: Provenance of the 'coin rewards stay' ruling not cited.
objections.resolution: Accepted. Cited as the creator ruling relayed with the mission brief and recorded in project memory.

objections.objection: STATE.md stale.
objections.resolution: Accepted. Updated.

objections.objection: Obsidian and quill listed as blockers though they block no goal alone.
objections.resolution: Accepted. Wording corrected.
